card.name: Spaces before numbers in UK-flavored text
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space or digit just before a number (date day, count, phone number) in British or UK-related web text. Also a few words like National or of in UK government settings.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The gap right before a day, count or phone number, in dates, statistics and helpline numbers.

modes.label: Digit inside a UK number
modes.description: A digit in a British standard code or year inside UK-themed text.

modes.label: UK policy wording
modes.description: A word in UK government education or policy phrases.
modes.example: sustainable development education to the<< National>> Curriculum review

card.writes: It pushes British terms such as UK, Labour, Brexit and Parliament, and suppresses US place names.
card.plain: It marks spots in a number where the text looks British, so UK-related words come next.
